# Copilot Instructions

Read and follow the shared [repository guidelines](../AGENTS.md) before making changes or reviewing code. `AGENTS.md` is the source of truth for development commands, architecture, testing, API documentation, design-system rules, and provider behavior.

Keep shared guidance in `AGENTS.md` rather than copying it here. This file is Copilot's entry point; any future Copilot-specific instruction must be explicitly labeled with its reason.
